title: Replace or clear one Project description without changing other Project state

requirements.invariant: A Project description is optional. UpdateProjectDetails carries one complete normalized replacement: leading/trailing whitespace is removed, whitespace-only input is clear, and no unapproved length cap or rewriting of accepted interior text is invented.

Updating description preserves the same stable ProjectID and authoritative ClientID relationship and cannot carry copied Client text, Client reassignment, frozen-display rewrite or Transfer/accounting ownership input.

UpdateProjectDetails is distinct from CreateProject, RenameProject, ArchiveProject, ConfigureProjectCategories, media capture/removal and Client correction. It cannot recreate the current generic field dictionary or partial multi-workflow edit.

UpdateProjectDetails expresses one typed business intent and exposes no arbitrary field map, collection/path/SQL string, generic CRUD, lifecycle toggle, delete flag, Client/category/media/child/accounting/history mutation or backend SDK type.

The exact Project-description replacement is bound to one OperationID, contract version, AccountID, actor PrincipalID and finite client-created time through the shared fingerprint/receipt lifecycle and defines no competing queue, retry, result or rejection semantics.

The command carries exactly one expected-revision precondition for the same Project subject so stale description intent cannot silently become last-write-wins; local construction does not decide authoritative conflict or idempotent-already-applied results.

requirements.section: Clients, Projects, notes, preferences, and reference data
requirements.invariant: One narrow backend-neutral Project-details operation accepts the validated command and returns the shared OperationReceipt or stable failure; local validation never substitutes for trusted membership, Project existence/revision or update authorization.

This Phase 1 command boundary is executable only with deterministic provider-free evidence while the shipped app remains unchanged and no Project table/handler, RLS, Sync Stream, Auth/provider choice, source transform, hosted resource or production authority is introduced.

items: ProjectDescriptionReplacement canonicalizes raw optional input to either clear or one leading/trailing-whitespace-trimmed nonblank String while preserving accepted interior text and adding no unapproved length cap.

ProjectDetailsUpdateDraft owns exact Account, actor, operation-contract, stable Project, complete description replacement, expected Project revision and finite capture time; it contains no name/Client/category/media/lifecycle/child/accounting/history input.

UpdateProjectDetailsPayload contains only ProjectID and canonical description replacement. UpdateProjectDetailsCommand binds it to the shared OperationEnvelope, derives the exact Project subject/fingerprint and exactly one same-subject expected-revision precondition, and revalidates duplicated evidence on decode.

ProjectDetailsUpdating is the narrow backend-neutral operation port returning the shared OperationReceipt; receipt validation requires exact OperationID and exposes no authoritative updated-row/result claim.

ProjectDetailsUpdateFailure exposes stable bounded time, binding, precondition, subject, fingerprint, receipt, local-acceptance and malformed-encoding codes while reusing shared typed identity and operation validators.

postgresSchema.notApplicable: This Phase 1 contract creates no projects table, description/revision/audit column, foreign key, check, index, view or migration.

serverHandlers.notApplicable: No authoritative UpdateProjectDetails handler, membership/Project lookup, revision lock, idempotency storage, audit timestamp, conflict result or server update exists.

dataApiGrants.notApplicable: No relation, view or function is exposed through the Supabase Data API and no grant is added.

rlsPolicies.notApplicable: Typed Account/actor/Project binding is not authorization. No membership predicate, grant, WITH CHECK policy or cross-tenant database test exists.

syncStreams.notApplicable: No PowerSync Stream, local Project row/details projection, optimistic overlay, upload connector or synchronized visibility/readiness claim is defined.

items: The command is canonical Codable evidence over draft, shared envelope, exact expected-revision precondition, Project subject and fingerprint; decode reconstructs through the same replacement/binding validators and byte-identical structured restart is required.

Changed Account, actor, contract, Project/description payload, revision subject/value/count, command subject, fingerprint or receipt OperationID fails atomically without rebinding identity or converting details into a generic Project update.

A deterministic reference adapter may accept the command into the shared OperationJournal and prove exact replay/receipt semantics; this is not physical durable-store, process/device restart, optimistic row, authoritative apply or offline-authorization evidence.

storageMedia.notApplicable: UpdateProjectDetails owns no attachment reference/bytes/retention behavior and cannot add, replace, detach or delete Project hero media.

appMcp.notApplicable: No Project edit UI, current app service, MCP tool/schema, transport, contract-catalog entry or app/MCP parity claim is wired.

migrationReconciliation.notApplicable: No Firebase Project document/generic field update, source export or description migration is decoded or transformed. Later migration must preserve/canonicalize optional description with explicit evidence.

observabilityRunbooks.notApplicable: Stable local failures are contract values only; no signal emission, metric, alert, audit sink or runbook action is introduced.

items: Implementation remains inside provider-free LedgerTargetCore and its tests and does not change or link either application project.

The slice cannot visibly or authoritatively update a Project, rename/archive/delete/reassign it, alter Client/category/media/child/accounting/history state, authorize membership, choose Auth, define provider/schema/migration behavior, activate a feature, deploy, release or cut over.
O-023/O-024/O-025, A-003/A-004/A-007/A-015/A-016, physical offline verification, production profiling and O-022 remain outside this command boundary.

verification.expected: Valid synthetic set and clear inputs produce typed exact-scope UpdateProjectDetails commands with canonical replacement and one same-Project revision, containing no rename/Client/category/media/lifecycle/child/accounting/history/generic-write input.

Set and clear commands round-trip byte-identically with exact Account/actor/contract/Operation/Project/revision/time/subject/fingerprint evidence and no backend path, provider, credential or authoritative result claim.

Noncanonical encoded replacement, invalid time and changed Account/actor/contract/Project/description/revision subject/value/count/command subject/fingerprint/receipt evidence fail atomically through stable diagnostic codes.

A deterministic reference port returns the shared queued receipt, exact replay returns the same receipt, same OperationID with changed Project/description/revision is refused, and a failing port returns no success receipt.

verification.owner: pull-request CI Isolated target environment job
verification.expected: The exact implementation commit passes conversion traceability, provider/source-contamination and generated-contract checks, the complete target suite, both target builds and clean artifacts without changing an application project or claiming server, authorization, provider, migration or production behavior.

notes: Decision-independent Phase 1 Project-details command only. The reviewed preserve/correct split keeps optional Project description while separating rename, Client relation, category configuration, media and lifecycle. O-023/O-024/O-025 remain fully open because this command carries no media deletion, Project deletion or Client correction. The slice stops before physical durable storage, authoritative server apply, schema/RLS/Sync/Auth/provider, app/MCP, source migration, hosted resources, production access or cutover.
